accepted.title: Whole-tone melodic spelling
accepted.rationale: Major-second spelling may be preferred for whole-tone inner-voice motion, distinguishing enharmonic candidates that melodic distance treats identically without constraining repeated pitches or chromatic semitones.

accepted.title: Overlap without crossing
accepted.rationale: For simultaneously attacking voices that remain strictly ordered, entering the partner's previous register may weaken line independence in a way not captured by present-time crossing penalties.

accepted.title: Leaping into a held-note semitone
accepted.rationale: Approaching an exact semitone clash with a sustained voice by more than two semitones may be less typical than stepwise contact, irrespective of crossing and deliberately excluding repeated pitches and compound intervals.
